1.explanation: This minimal example mounts a Carbon ComboBox and attaches a React ref via useRef(). On mount, you’ll see the console warning about giving refs to function components and comboRef.current will be null. This reproduces the bug reported in Carbon v7.35.0: ComboBox is a plain function component and has not been wrapped with React.forwardRef(), so it does not accept ref props.
1.bug_scenario: When you try to attach a React ref to the Carbon ComboBox (now implemented as a function component), React issues a console warning “Function components cannot be given refs. Attempts to access this ref will fail. Did you mean to use React.forwardRef()?” and the ref value remains undefined/null. In other words, passing a ref prop to <ComboBox /> does nothing — the underlying DOM node isn’t exposed.
